app_fee.value: S$50 (nett) non-refundable application fee per research application (waived only for nationals who have resided since birth in Singapore or 55 listed developing countries; India is not on the list).
app_fee.quote: An application fee of S$50 (Nett) will be charged for each Research application. Payment can be made online before submitting application by VISA/Mastercard.

fee_waiver.value: Automatic application fee waiver applies only to nationals who have resided since birth in Singapore or 55 listed developing countries (India is not on the 56-country waiver list, so Indian applicants pay S$50).
fee_waiver.quote: Wavier of Application fees will be extended to applicants from the countries listed below, if they are nationals of an eligible country and have resided there since birth.

gre_general.value: GRE/GMAT/GATE scores are optional across NTU research programs (minimum 90th percentile GATE within 3 years accepted from Indian applicants to strengthen applications), except where specific schools/programs require or do not require them.
gre_general.quote: GRE / GMAT / GATE are optional*. | Strong evidence of quantitative, verbal, and/or analytical skills through these tests will enhance your application.

toefl_min.value: Central graduate research guide requires a 'good TOEFL/IELTS score' without a university-wide numerical cutoff; individual schools set minimums (EEE 100, MSE 100, ASE 5.0 new scale, IGP Neuroscience 105).
toefl_min.quote: English Language Proficiency: A good TOEFL/IELTS score for applicants whose Bachelor’s degree is not conducted in English.

ielts_min.value: Central graduate research guide does not specify a university-wide IELTS band minimum; individual schools set minimums (EEE 6.5, MSE 6.5, ASE 6.5, IGP Neuroscience 7.0).
ielts_min.quote: English Language Proficiency: A good TOEFL/IELTS score for applicants whose Bachelor’s degree is not conducted in English.

english_waiver.value: Applicants whose tertiary studies were taught in English may request a TOEFL/IELTS waiver by submitting an official Medium of Instruction certification letter from their home university (case-by-case at the School's discretion).
english_waiver.quote: If the medium of instruction used in your studies is English, you may obtain a letter from your home University to certify the medium of instruction for waiver.

also.quote: Test score (TOEFL/IELTS, GRE) exemptions are granted on a case-by-case basis at the School's discretion. Contact the School directly for more information.

notes: Covers 17 of 18 Atlas STEM fields across 13 PhD programs (no standalone Astronomy PhD at NTU Singapore). Note two school-specific August 2027 intake deadlines differ from NTU's standard 2027-01-31 cutoff: LKCMedicine (biomed) closes 2026-12-31, and CEE (civil) closes 2027-02-28. International PhD Research Scholarship stipends were revised effective January 2026 to S$3,000/month (+ up to S$500/month post-QE) with full tuition coverage, and NPGS/PGA to S$4,300/month.
